title: A Contact for the Drop
author: Silas Voss
blurb: Felix Joubert, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
